author: mapcomplete
attribution: Photo: mapcomplete, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Panoramax. Source: https://panoramax.mapcomplete.org/#focus=pic&pic=55b5f51d-0cfc-4da3-b05a-fdd76fdaa99a. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. crop 0,1279,1200,2179 of the 3000x4000 HD picture.
notes: Engraved grey letters running bottom-to-top up the side of a concrete skate ramp in Battery Park, V&A Waterfront, Cape Town; the initial 'B' is below the frame edge so only '...ATTERY PARK' is visible, and a skater (face blurred, back to camera) partly covers the stone.
